checklist.question: Is there an approved Education Director on-site at the time of Inspection?
Are all teaching staff approved for their respective roles?
Has a sample review of children's medical records including immunizations been completed?
For staff on site, has a review of Staff medical records, including immunizations, been completed?
Are the evacuation routes and emergency phone numbers posted on site?
Are minimum staff-to-child ratios and group sizes maintained in each classroom?
Is at least one staff member on site certified in CPR, First Aid and epinephrine auto-injector administration?
Is there a complete first aid kit and at least two unexpired epinephrine auto-injectors with retractable needles on-site?
Are all sinks equipped with liquid soap dispensers, paper towels/sanitary dryers and hand-washing signs?
Are all indoor areas and premises well-maintained and free of electrical, chemical, mechanical and other hazards?
Are all hallways, stairways and exits free from obstruction at the time of inspection?
Are approved window guards installed in all windows except fire escape windows?
Are fire safety measures provided and in good working order**?
Is there evidence that the program's activities promote the physical, intellectual, and emotional wellbeing of the children in care?
